posts.text: I applaud all the dunking on Rolling Stone for its utterly predictable, conformist, suck-uppery to Piker. My only objection is that a lot of it implies normal people *should be* scared of Piker. They shouldn't be. He's a poseur and fraud. The only people who should be afraid of him are Democrats who want the Democratic Party to be appealing to mainstream American voters.
